evidence: The Whitcombe Pass Track takes you through the very rugged bush clad valleys of the lower Hokitika and Whitcombe Rivers to the Main Divide.
From here travel to the Pass is via the riverbed, crossing the river where convenient.

side_trips.name: Wilkinson Hut
side_trips.quote: a sign posted side track which leads to Wilkinson Hut

doubts: Page does not say whether walkers return; time is 'to Whitcombe Pass' with no return, so taken as one_way (could be out and back). Start: the road end car park is not any feature, so null. Cataract Creek crossing: the text says only 'crossing Cataract Creek' (a Cataract Creek swing bridge is mentioned earlier), so no ford how is given. The Rapid Creek cableway crossing is listed as a via without a how. Cataract Creek's ref T2 is the river entry. Hokitika Gorge Walk is not named on the page (only 'the Hokitika Gorge'), so ref null.
